blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several areas in Metro Manila, Cavite and rizal will experience water supply interruptions from Nov. 10 onwards due to maintenance activities. In an advisory, Maynilad Water Services, Inc. said maintenance activities will be conducted to keep the water distribution system “safe, reliable and in good condition.” Manila Water likewise announced that it will also conduct maintenance and service improvement activities in parts of Metro Manila and the province of Rizal.
